suite.name: gemma4-31b-cpu-sapphire-rapids
suite.description: Gemma 4 31B (dense 60-layer, 50 sliding-window + 10 global attention layers) on Intel(R) Xeon(R) Sapphire Rapids (AVX-512 + AMX) across CPU runtimes (LiteRT-LM XNNPACK & YNNPACK, llama.cpp, OpenVINO, XLA/PJRT CPU) grouped by precision track (INT4, INT8, BF16).

audio.note: Official google/gemma-4-31B-it has audio_config: null (only Gemma 4 E2B and E4B include model.audio_tower). Gemma 4 Conformer audio kernel profiling uses gemma-4-E2B-it.litertlm (audio_204: [1, 816, 128] -> [1, 204, 1536]) as reference.

configs.quant_note: Official Google QAT Q4_0 GGUF (google/gemma-4-31B-it-qat-q4_0-gguf, 32 threads on Socket 0)
Official ggml-org Q4_0 GGUF (ggml-org/gemma-4-31B-it-GGUF) with flash-attn + batch=2048
LiteRT-LM (.litertlm, dynamic_wi4_afp32 exported from google/gemma-4-31B-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized via litert-torch) with XNNPACK delegate (AVX-512 VNNI + AMX, 32 threads)
LiteRT-LM (.litertlm, dynamic_wi4_afp32) with XNNPACK delegate (AVX-512 VNNI + AMX, 56 physical cores on Socket 0)
LiteRT-LM (.litertlm, dynamic_wi4_afp32) with experimental YNNPACK delegate (--ynnpack / --enable_ynnpack=true, AVX-512 + AMX, 32 threads)
LiteRT-LM (.litertlm, dynamic_wi4_afp32) with experimental YNNPACK delegate (--ynnpack / --enable_ynnpack=true, AVX-512 + AMX, 56 physical cores on Socket 0)
Official OpenVINO INT4 model (OpenVINO/gemma-4-31B-it-int4-ov) with oneDNN AMX/AVX-512 at 32 threads
Official OpenVINO INT4 model (OpenVINO/gemma-4-31B-it-int4-ov) with oneDNN AMX/AVX-512 across all 56 physical cores on Socket 0
Official OpenVINO INT8 model (OpenVINO/gemma-4-31B-it-int8-ov) with oneDNN AMX-INT8
Official ggml-org BF16 GGUF (ggml-org/gemma-4-31B-it-GGUF) with Sapphire Rapids AMX BF16 kernels
Official Google BF16 safetensors (google/gemma-4-31B-it) on XLA:CPU Next with YNNPACK fusion + AMX BF16

configs.disabled_reason: XLA:CPU experimental oneDNN backend (--xla_cpu_use_onednn=true) segfaults (SIGSEGV, exit code -11) inside ThunkExecutor::Execute on 1,024-token batched 4D attention contractions on Intel AMX
configs.quant_note: Official Google BF16 safetensors (google/gemma-4-31B-it) on XLA:CPU Next with oneDNN custom-call AMX BF16
